description: Source code for automation engine in a software project, managing message processing, engine registration, start/stop, and state management.

methods.name: isRunning
methods.description: Checks if the message thread is currently running, with thread-safe access.

methods.name: stopEngineThread
methods.description: Stops the engine message thread safely, disables queue, and waits for thread to terminate.

methods.name: freeEngineList
methods.description: Frees resources associated with an automationEngineOps instance.

methods.name: injectRequiredJSON
methods.description: Injects sun times and current event time into a JSON object, converting times to milliseconds.

methods.name: engineMessageThread
methods.description: Main thread function processing messages from the queue, invoking engine process methods, and measuring processing time.

methods.name: automationEngineInit
methods.description: Initializes the automation engine subsystem, creating message queue and engine list.

methods.name: destroyMessageQueueJSON
methods.description: Deletes a cJSON item, used as callback for queue destruction.

methods.name: automationEngineDestroy
methods.description: Stops the engine thread, destroys message queue and engine list, and cleans up resources.

methods.name: automationEngineRegister
methods.description: Registers a new automation engine operations instance.

methods.name: automationEngineStart
methods.description: Starts the message processing thread if not already running.

methods.name: automationEngineStop
methods.description: Stops the message processing thread safely.

methods.name: automationEngineEnable
methods.description: Enables all registered engines with given specification ID and details.

methods.name: automationEngineDisable
methods.description: Disables engines associated with the given specification ID.

methods.name: automationEngineGetState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the engine associated with the given specification ID.

methods.name: automationEnginePost
methods.description: Posts a message to the engine's message queue after injecting required JSON fields.
